title: Head (Planning), Sustainability Office
description:
**[What the role is]**

As part of the Sustainability Office, you will help promote Singapore’s aviation interests to sustain the long-term competitiveness of the Singapore air hub. This will involve overseeing and coordinating matters relating to aviation environmental protection and driving the development and implementation of sustainability roadmaps for domestic airport emissions and international aviation emissions.

**[What you will be working on]**

You will lead a team to analyze global aviation trends and monitor broader environmental developments to refine and implement CAAS’ sustainability strategy for the Airport, Airline and Air Traffic Management domains as laid out in the Singapore Sustainable Air Hub Blueprint. You will also align policy positions regarding issues with environmental implications across various CAAS divisions, other government agencies, and aviation stakeholders. The team will also analyze and provide recommendations on key aviation environmental issues discussed at the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and other international and regional forums.

To succeed in this job, you should have good interpersonal skills to engage stakeholders on aviation and environmental issues. You should have strong thinking skills and analytical skills to sense-make underlying trends and developments from both structured and unstructured information sources. You should also be interested in international affairs and aviation climate change related issues.

**[What we are looking for]**

* Background in Environmental Studies/Sciences, Engineering, Business, Economics or Geography preferred
* 10 or more years of work experience. Supervisory experience is preferred.
* Prior relevant environment or aviation-related experience would be an advantage
* Good team player with excellent verbal, written communication and analytical skills
* Self-motivated and independent, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment
* Able to travel on occasion for work

Note: Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance.

description:
**Job Title**

Environmental Maintenance Coordinator

**Job Description Summary**

We are seeking an Environment Control Coordinator to oversee environmental health, cleanliness, and sanitation standards across the assigned portfolio, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and maintaining a safe, clean, and pleasant environment for all stakeholders.

**Job Description**

**About the Job:**
------------------

* Oversee the daily operations of environmental cleaning and sanitation services, ensuring compliance with prescribed service standards.
* Coordinate and supervise cleaning contractors, pest control service providers, and environmental maintenance vendors.
* Conduct regular inspections of common areas, public facilities, and amenities to ensure cleanliness, hygiene, and environmental standards are maintained.
* Monitor and ensure compliance with environmental health regulations, workplace safety requirements, and company policies.
* Manage and follow up on environmental-related feedback, complaints, and service requests, ensuring timely resolution.
* Ensure proper maintenance and cleanliness of public amenities, including toilets, common areas, and refuse collection points.
* Maintain inspection records, reports, and documentation related to environmental management activities.
* Liaise with regulatory agencies, contractors, and stakeholders on environmental health matters and inspections.
* Support environmental improvement initiatives and campaigns to enhance cleanliness, hygiene, and community well-being.
* Perform any other duties as assigned by Management.

**About You:**
--------------

* Minimum Nitec or Higher Nitec qualification.
* Must be qualified by NEA for managing hawker centres and neighbourhood park toilets.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in environmental services, cleaning operations, facilities management, or environmental health management.
* Experience supervising cleaning contractors, service providers, and environmental maintenance activities.
* Good knowledge of environmental health regulations, sanitation standards, and cleanliness management practices.
* Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
